notes: Game Bot V0.14: Follow-up chat edits write the brief and rebuild (darker, boss, faster player, more/fewer enemies, weather, time of day, colors, extra level, undo, rename). Cancel/stop a running hidden Unity/Unreal job; retry a failed build; continue-with-placeholders starts a build that had not started. Typo correction uses a common-English dictionary and never rewrites real words (words, loop, art, ready stay put); known misspellings like wnat/plataformer are fixed silently and titles such as Pine Dash and Shadow Gate are kept. Yes after a typo confirm resumes the original request. The model stays loaded during Unity/Unreal builds. If Ollama drops mid-request, Game Bot shows a clear message, retries once, and reloads the model with the edition num_ctx (8192 on 8gb), not the 4096 default. AMD VRAM is read from DXGI DedicatedVideoMemory and registry qwMemorySize, so the context meter basis no longer shows 0 GB VRAM. Instant answers for version/update and for running unelevated. Xbox/PlayStation/Switch questions say honestly that Game Bot builds Windows PC games and does not publish to consoles. Asset-plan placeholder phrases are honored. GameBot.exe FileVersion matches the app version. Bring-your-own model support in Settings (local Ollama, LM Studio/llama.cpp, or optional cloud keys kept DPAPI-encrypted). Bug-report preview is redacted and never auto-sent. GAMEBOT_UPDATE_TEST is a local-feed-only update path (never the live website).
